{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693854278,"sessionID":"ses_e23eb0957ffeuCKJnENbEAM2zk","part":{"id":"prt_1dc16f41e001b9rOujorWcceAM","messageID":"msg_1dc16d51b001THETeF12BBs2if","sessionID":"ses_e23eb0957ffeuCKJnENbEAM2zk","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. From minute 77 to the end (minute 120), all four customer-facing services were at a 0% error rate. Mobile-api, the main earner at $8,700/min, recovered at about minute 47, after a stretch where my own fix pushed its errors to 52% for roughly 10 minutes.\n\nI found four separate causes:\n\n1. **experiments-svc config change at −25 (affected admin-portal and web-storefront):** the change removed `orders.write` from its token scope. Its callers retried the failures until it was overloaded, at 90% errors. I reverted the config, which took effect at minute 12. The retry overload didn't clear by itself, so I rejected 60% of its traffic from minute 18 to minute 36 to drain it, then lifted that.\n2. **events-queue deploy v145 at −41 (affected mobile-api):** it switched the message format to `v3`, and giftcards-svc couldn't read it. That gave mobile-api about 4.2% errors from the start. I rolled the deploy back at minute 33.\n   - This step cost the most money on its own. During the rollback, callers' retries overloaded events-queue, and mobile-api errors rose to 52% from about minute 38. I rejected 60% of events-queue traffic from minute 42 to minute 47, after which mobile-api dropped to 0%.\n   - Adding replicas to events-queue before the rollback would probably have avoided this.\n3. **payments-svc deploy v48 at −13 (affected admin-portal and web-storefront):** it fixed the database connection pool at 4 connections, causing connection timeouts and about 38% errors. I rolled it back at minute 71, and it finished at minute 76.\n4. **ledger-svc config change at minute 46 (affected admin-portal):** a new fault during the shift. It cut `entry_ttl_s` from 600 to 1 second, so entries expired before anyone read them. I reverted it at minute 64.\n\n**Alerts and changes I left alone:** flags-svc's high CPU recovered by itself, and the other recent changes looked harmless when I read them. I didn't scale anything, so there are no extra replica costs, and all throttles are off.","time":{"start":1794693854238,"end":1794693854274}}}
